name: 15461 · Masontown, PA
findings: ZIP 15461 (Masontown) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15461 (Masontown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
